Sal was a good man, but he also had the ability to snarl back at those who attempted to hurt him. He is the kind who avoids conflict. Additionally, he didn't appear to support violence as he objected when his companions threatened to kill Travis in jest for harassing Sal. Despite the fact that Sal is a man, he doesn't appear to care how others see him or about gender norms, as seen by his typically feminine hairdo and the fact that he didn't bother to correct Miss Rosenberg when she first referred to him as a female. Sal opened up to people with considerable reluctance and seemed to be noticeably more cynical and untrusting of others.
